audit_items.proof_trace: The property requires the signature to bind to (amount, round_id, investor_addr). The implementation satisfies this via `abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, address(this), block.chainid, cachedInvestAmount, cachedTokenAllocationRate, _actionType)`: `msg.sender` binds investor_addr, `address(this)` binds round_id (each Legion round is a distinct deployed contract with a unique address), and `cachedInvestAmount` binds amount. Single-use enforcement via `s_usedSignatures` nonce prevents replay within the same round.
